record.issue_text: The validation regex's `{2,5}` TLD cap rejects legitimate long gTLDs such as `.photography`.

adjudication.rationale: In the newly added model `app/models/embeddable_host.rb`, the validation `validates_format_of :host, :with => /...\.[a-z]{2,5}.../i` explicitly caps the TLD length to 5 characters. This will reject valid modern gTLDs longer than 5 (e.g. `.photography`), preventing legitimate embeddable hosts from being saved/used.
